items.t: 12-volt battery failure leaves car dead
items.job: Replace 12-volt AGM battery and reset battery monitor
items.note: Owners report dealer prices from about $175 to $370 installed.

items.t: Clunk from rear when accelerating or braking
items.job: Replace rear upper trailing arm(s)
items.note: Low end is one arm; high end is both arms at list price. Hours are from TSB 22-2253.

items.t: Water leaking into the liftgate
items.job: Reseal liftgate tail lamps with butyl tape
items.note: Labor time is from TSB 23-2360. Covered by the new-vehicle warranty while it lasts.

items.t: Touchscreen freezes or goes black
items.job: Soft reset and software update
items.note: A soft reset is free and most fixes arrive by over-the-air update.
